## Summary

Explain what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] Local checks or reproduction steps are documented.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, customer information or raw production logs.
- [ ] Expert knowledge separates facts and hypotheses.

## Knowledge contributions

- [ ] Mark new knowledge cases as drafts pending expert review.
- [ ] State applicable platform, configuration and DBMS versions.
- [ ] Explain the evidence supporting a claimed root cause.
